products.name: Remind
products.note: Found in the research for The AI Ready School; not independently verified. AI features: not verified. Use: Class and school messaging. Who: Teachers, families. Student age: Not verified. Privacy: Not verified. Price: Remind Chat free; Remind Hub paid by quote (third party).

reading.body:
Remind is catalogued as an education AI product, but nothing in the record verifies that it has AI features at all.

The only AI claim is an entry in the research for The AI Ready School, which itself states the product was not independently verified and its AI features are not verified. Everything else in the record is messaging: two-way communication for teachers, families, and community groups, message history logs, and testimonials about registration notices, campus alerts, and health and safety messages. The company's own positioning points K-12 schools and districts to ParentSquare, leaving Remind for youth organizations, sports programs, and nonprofits.

For AI specifically, this is a data gap rather than a finding. A messaging platform that carries school and family communications sits close to student data, which is where AI features would raise the sharpest questions, and the record answers none of them. Student age, privacy terms, and AI capability are all marked not verified.

What the data does not cover: no lawsuits, SEC filings, patents, or MCP servers are recorded. It also carries no compute, data center, or power figures, so it says nothing about the infrastructure constraints that govern AI scaling. The price detail, Remind Chat free and Remind Hub paid by quote, is the only commercial fact present.
